**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

The document contains no non-solicitation, no-poach, or no-hire covenant of any kind. Targeted searches for "solicit", "employ or engage", "hire", "induce", "recruit", and "personnel" returned no results, and the only "employee" references — p0244, p0284 (no-recourse against members/officers/employees of the Depositor and Servicer) and p0291 (definition of "Indemnified Person") — are standard securitization no-recourse and indemnity provisions, not restrictive covenants.

This sits at our **preferred** position under NOSOLICIT (no non-solicit binding the Customer), so nothing needs to be added or narrowed. Consistent with the transaction structure (an ABS servicing/marketing arrangement among Verizon affiliates), an employee non-solicit would be out of place here, and we should not volunteer one.
